name: MakeLLM
description: Generate Geometry Dash 2.2 levels with any OpenAI-compatible LLM — right inside the level editor. Physics-validated: passable, no secret-ways.

base-url.name: Base URL
base-url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Omniroute: http://localhost:20128/v1 · Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1 · LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1 · OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1

api-key.name: API Key
api-key.description: Bearer key. Leave empty for local servers without auth. Stays on this device.

model.name: Model
model.description: Model name to pass in the request (e.g. gpt-4o, qwen2.5-14b, deepseek-chat).

difficulty.name: Difficulty
difficulty.description: easy / medium / hard / extreme — or free-form (e.g. 'demon', 'tutorial').

style.name: Style
style.description: modern / retro / flow / memory — or free-form.

max-objects.name: Max Objects
max-objects.description: Hard cap on objects per generation.

refinement-rounds.name: Refinement Rounds
refinement-rounds.description: How many times the AI may fix its level after the physics validator rejects it. Each round = one extra API call.

unique-seed.name: Unique Seed
unique-seed.description: Inject a random theme/palette/mechanic into every generation so no two levels are alike.

prevent-secret-way.name: Prevent Secret Ways
prevent-secret-way.description: Reject levels that complete themselves with zero input, and flight sections without ceilings.

enable-triggers.name: Triggers & Colors
enable-triggers.description: Allow the AI to place color/move/pulse/alpha/rotate/spawn/toggle/stop triggers and assign group IDs.

ground-y.name: Ground Y
ground-y.description: Editor Y of the ground row. 105 is default. Lower if blocks float; higher if they bury.

spawn-batch-size.name: Spawn Speed
spawn-batch-size.description: Objects placed per editor tick. Higher = faster but heavier per frame.
